answered_criteria.prompt: Document that the member has moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis.

unanswered_required_items.prompt: Confirm the member is not using adalimumab concomitantly with any other biologic drug or targeted synthetic drug for the same indication.

Document improvement from baseline in stool frequency, rectal bleeding, urgency of defecation, CRP, fecal calprotectin, mucosal appearance on imaging/endoscopy, or disease activity scoring tools (e.g., UCEIS/Mayo) for ulcerative colitis.
Document remission for ulcerative colitis in a member using adalimumab.
